case.pattern_description: The online transaction occurred from a new device with a high risk score and matches a historically confirmed fraud case on this account involving customer denial.
case.summary: Case HHG-013 involves a fraudulent card-not-present transaction for $35.66 originating from a new device. Although the device fingerprint was shared with many other cards and did not indicate a specific fraud ring, customer validation confirmed that the cardholder did not make the purchase and still possessed the card. Based on this customer denial, the card was blocked and the case was closed with a confirmed fraud verdict.
